implementation: The flutter_background plugin declared REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS even though the app config used shouldRequestBatteryOptimizationsOff=false and the product does not request battery exemption. The app manifest now removes that dependency permission at merge time while preserving MediaProjection foreground service declarations.
